# Card 381: preliminary single-reader candidate

[Catalogue](https://crypto.hcportal.eu/dashboard/cryptograms/1700) · [Picture original](https://api.hcportal.eu/media/5160/pc_hcp_381_pic.JPG) · [Address original](https://api.hcportal.eu/media/5161/pc_hcp_381_adr.JPG) · [Full evidence JSON](381.json)

**Partial research candidate; not a solved card.** One key-visible AI source reading was frozen before the first computational decode. Subsequent source review and interpretation used the same context and were nonblind. A second source reading and external confirmation are still needed.

Eleven sloping/stepped lower rows clockwise270. The parenthetical numeral-like cluster after tm5 is masked: its ordinary/cipher/date/time role is not assigned or decoded as digits. Marked-r cap provisional; ordinary date-like heading/publisher matter excluded.

The original images/crops remain private. Picture SHA256: `4b010668b28eed2fa4b63796440b6da09ffbe08c0b1d99d599a0bf40ad2a3753`. Coordinates and full acquisition metadata are in the JSON. Ordinary dates, addresses and postal text are excluded without historical authentication.

## Readable fragments

These are separate editorial proposals tied to exact literal fragments. They are not a continuous translation; omitted stretches remain unresolved. Czech diacritics and question readings are editorial; a proposal does not establish the role of a question-shaped source mark.

proposed_czech:
Aničko moje rozmilá, píši dnes ještě jednou následkem nepředvídané práce. Nařídilo nám dnes totiž ředitelství účetní výkazy, s kterými nemohu býti před úterým hotov, kterého dne se mají předložiti.

Prosím tudíž své [srdéčko?], aby hledělo zaříditi [pořad?] té práce na neděli a pondělí příští (dne 17. a 18.).

Tisíc vřelých pus ti posílá tvůj Pepouš.

Prosím o sdělení, může-li Anička v [navržené?] dva dny přijeti.
proposed_english:
My dear Anička, I write once again today because of unforeseen work. We were ordered today by the management to prepare accounting statements, which I cannot finish before Tuesday, the day on which they must be submitted.

I therefore ask my [sweetheart?] to try to arrange [the schedule?] for this work for next Sunday and Monday (the 17th and 18th).

Your Pepouš sends you a thousand warm kisses.

Please let me know whether Anička can come on the [proposed?] two days.
